Wrath R1.new: Causes 15 Nature damage to the target.
Wrath R1.old: Causes 10 Nature damage to the target.

Wrath R8.new: Causes 91 Nature damage to the target.
Wrath R8.old: Causes 61 Nature damage to the target.

Holy Strike.new: An instant strike that causes 29% weapon damage plus an additional 17 as Holy damage.
Holy Strike.old: An instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 17 as Holy damage.

Righteous Fury.new: Increases the threat generated by your Holy attacks by 60%. Lasts 30 min.
Righteous Fury.old: Increases the threat generated by your Holy attacks by 90%. Lasts 30 min.

Slam.new: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 32.
Slam.old: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 32.

Sunder Armor.new: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 450 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat. Can be applied up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.
Sunder Armor.old: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 450 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat. Can be applied up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

Life Tap.new: Converts 20 Health into 20 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted.
Life Tap.old: Converts 20 health into 20 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount of Mana converted. Mana gained is increased by your Spirit.

Eureka!.new: Your next 3 damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage.
Eureka!.old: Your next 3 damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 50% and deal 10% more damage.

Study.new: Perform spell research, resulting in a bundle of scrolls. Requires a suitable library.
Study.old: Perform spell research, resulting in a bundle of scrolls. Requires a suitable library.

Research.new: Research the magical arts with the help of a library.
Research.old: Research the magical arts with the help of a library.

Lightning Bolt.new: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 45 Nature damage.
Lightning Bolt.old: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 35 Nature damage.

Lava Burst SoD.new: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 164 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.
Lava Burst SoD.old: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 113 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

Primal Bite SoD.new: Bite the target for 100% normal damage plus 26.
Primal Bite SoD.old: Mangle the target for 100% normal damage plus 26.

Hot Streak aura.new: Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch grant Hot Streak for 20 sec. Hot Streak reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.
Hot Streak aura.old: Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch grant Hot Streak for 15 sec. Hot Streak reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.

Library Shelf.new: Summon a shelf of books to a campsite, allowing it to function as a library. Requires a Campfire nearby.
Library Shelf.old: Summon a shelf of books to a campsite, allowing it to function as a library. Requires a Campfire nearby.

Siphon the Grave.new: When your Mana falls below 15% restore 600 Mana over 15 sec. This effect can only trigger once every 5 min.

Rotmending.new: Grant your healing spells a chance to apply Rotmending, restoring 40 Health every 3 sec for 15 sec.

t:PALADIN:Holy Power.new: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock and Holy Strike spells by 15%, and all other spells by 5%.
t:PALADIN:Holy Power.old: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock spell by 15%, and all other spells by 5%.

t:PALADIN:Sacred Arbiter.new: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.
t:PALADIN:Sacred Arbiter.old: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 10% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

t:PALADIN:Two-Handed Weapon Specializati.new: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 6%.
t:PALADIN:Two-Handed Weapon Specializati.old: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 9%.

t:PALADIN:Vengeance.new: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike. Stacks up to 3 times.
t:PALADIN:Vengeance.old: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a critical strike. Stacks up to 5 times.

t:PALADIN:Twist of Light.new: Reduces the Mana cost of your Seal spells by 20%, and when you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, gain an Echo of that Seal. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.
t:PALADIN:Twist of Light.old: When you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, gain an Echo. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.

t:PALADIN:Improved Holy Strike.new: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 2 sec.
t:PALADIN:Improved Holy Strike.old: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 2 sec.

t:PALADIN:Crusade.new: Increases all damage dealt by 2%. Increased by an additional 2% against Demon and Undead targets.
t:PALADIN:Crusade.old: Increases all damage dealt by 2%. Increased by an additional 2% against Demon and Undead targets.

t:WARRIOR:Improved Slam.new: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3.0 sec.
t:WARRIOR:Improved Slam.old: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts your melee swing time.

t:WARRIOR:Bloodthrill.new: Your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend have a 20% chance to allow the use of your Overpower ability on the target. Lasts 6 sec.
t:WARRIOR:Bloodthrill.old: Your melee attacks against targets afflicted by your Rend have a 10% chance to activate your Overpower ability for 1 attack on your current target. Lasts 6 sec.

t:SHAMAN:Elemental Fury.new: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.
t:SHAMAN:Elemental Fury.old: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

t:SHAMAN:Elemental Alacrity.new: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.50 sec.
t:SHAMAN:Elemental Alacrity.old: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.50 sec.

t:SHAMAN:Call of Thunder.new: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 3%.
t:SHAMAN:Call of Thunder.old: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 3%.

t:SHAMAN:Rage of the Farseer.new: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.
t:SHAMAN:Rage of the Farseer.old: Increases your melee attack speed and spell casting speed by 30% for 25 sec.

t:SHAMAN:Lava Burst.new: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 164 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.
t:SHAMAN:Lava Burst.old: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 113 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

t:HUNTER:Strider Kick.new: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.
t:HUNTER:Strider Kick.old: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage.

t:MAGE:Hot Streak.new: Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch grant Hot Streak for 20 sec. Hot Streak reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.
t:MAGE:Hot Streak.old: Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch grant Hot Streak for 15 sec. Hot Streak reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.

t:MAGE:Wake of Fire.new: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast cast within 30 sec by 50%.
t:MAGE:Wake of Fire.old: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast cast within 20 sec by 50%.

t:DRUID:Primal Bite.new: Bite the target for 100% normal damage plus 26.
t:DRUID:Primal Bite.old: Mangle the target for 100% normal damage plus 26.

t:DRUID:Blood Frenzy.new: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.
t:DRUID:Blood Frenzy.old: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

t:DRUID:Ferocity.new: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 5 Rage or Energy.
t:DRUID:Ferocity.old: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Mangle, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 5 Rage or Energy.

t:DRUID:Berserk.new: Causes your Primal Bite ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.
t:DRUID:Berserk.old: Causes your Mangle ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.

t:PRIEST:Devouring Contagion.new: Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 10 yards for the remaining duration.
t:PRIEST:Devouring Contagion.old: Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague it is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 10 yards for the remaining duration.
